course_2a_position: Optional Senior/BI path; very high Data Engineering overlap.
overlap_with_c2b: C2B B04 owns the fast-track DA-to-DE version of warehousing/data-quality competencies; C2-06 itself is not required.
overlap_with_c3: C3 uses these concepts operationally in pipelines/platforms. Direct-path learners receive required prereqs through C2B.
skip_rule: A learner following Course 1 -> C2B -> C3 may skip all of C2-06 if C2B entry/exit gates are satisfied.
c2_07_boundary: Cloud/Fabric ecosystem, identity, workspaces/deployment, refresh/gateway, governance/monitoring belong primarily to C2-07.
